Hum sab apne aamal ka khud aaina hain. Yeh kai dafa bayan ho chuka hai ke jis cheez par qasam khai jaye agar woh radd karne ki cheez ho toh qasam se pehle 'la' ka kalma nafi ki ta'eed ke liye lana jaiz hota hai. Yahan qayamat ke hone par aur jahilon ke is qaul ki tardeed par ke qayamat na hogi, qasam khai ja rahi hai, toh farmata hai: Qasam hai qayamat ke din ki aur qasam hai malamat karne wali jaan ki. 

Hadrat Hasan toh farmate hain qayamat ki qasam hai aur malamat karne wale nafs ki qasam nahi hai. Hadrat Qatadah farmate hain dono ki qasam hai. Hasan aur A'raj ki qira'at aayat (La uqsimu bi-yaumil qiyamah) hai, is se bhi Hadrat Hasan ke qaul ki ta'eed hoti hai is liye ke un ke nazdeek pehle ki qasam hai aur dusre ki nahi. Lekin sahih qaul yahi hai ke dono ki qasam khai hai, jaise ke Hadrat Qatadah ka farman hai. Ibn Abbas aur Saeed bin Jubair se bhi yahi marwi hai aur Imam Ibn Jarir ka mukhtar qaul bhi yahi hai.

Yaum-e-Qayamat ko toh har shakhs janta hi hai. Nafs-e-Lawwamah ki tafseer mein Hadrat Hasan Basri (Rahimahullah) se marwi hai ke is se murad momin ka nafs hai, woh har waqt apne ta'een malamat hi karta rehta hai ke yun kyun keh diya? Yeh kyun kha liya? Yeh khayal dil mein kyun aaya? Haan, fasiq o fajir ghafil hota hai, use kya padi jo apne nafs ko roke. 

Yeh bhi marwi hai ke zameen o aasman ki tamam makhlooq qayamat ke din apne ta'een malamat karegi, khair wale khair ki kami par aur sharr wale sharr ke sarzad hone par. Yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke is se murad mazmoom nafs hai jo nafarman ho, faut shuda par nadim hone wala aur is par malamat karne wala. Imam Ibn Jarir farmate hain yeh sab aqwal qareeb qareeb hain, matlab yeh hai ke woh nafs wala hai jo neki ki kami par, burai ke ho jaane par apne nafs ko malamat karta hai aur faut shuda par nadamat karta hai.

Phir farmata hai: Kya insan yeh soche hue hai ke hum qayamat ke din is ki haddiyon ke jama karne par qadir na honge? Yeh toh nihayat ghalat khayal hai, hum use mutafarriq jagah se jama kar ke dobara khada karenge aur is ki balisht balisht bana denge. Ibn Abbas waghera farmate hain, yaani hum qadir hain ke ise oont ya ghore ke talwe ki tarah bana denge. 

Imam Ibn Jarir farmate hain, yaani duniya mein bhi agar hum chahte ise aisa kar dete. Aayat ke lafzon se toh zahir yahi maloom hota hai ke (Qadirina) haal hai (Najma'u) se, yaani kya insan yeh guman karta hai ke hum is ki haddiyan jama na karenge? Haan haan, hum anqareeb jama karenge, dar'anhalike humein un ke jama karne ki qudrat hai, balke agar hum chahein toh jitna yeh tha is se bhi kuch zyada bana kar ise uthayenge, is ki ungliyon ke sire tak barabar kar ke paida karenge. Ibn Qutaibah aur Zajjaj ke qaul ke yahi ma'ni hain.

Phir farmata hai ke insan apne aage fisq-o-fujoor karna chahta hai yaani qadam ba qadam barh raha hai, umidein bandhe hue hai, kehta jata hai ke gunah kar to loon tauba bhi ho jayegi qiyamat ke din se jo us ke aage hai kufr karta hai, woh goya apne sar par sawar ho kar aage barh raha hai, har waqt yehi paya jata hai ke ek ek qadam apne nafs ko Allah ki masiyat ki taraf barhata jata hai magar jin par Rab ka raham hai, aksar salaf ka qaul is ayat ki tafseer mein yehi hai ke gunahon mein jaldi karta hai aur tauba mein takheer karta hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain jo yaum-e-hisab ka munkar hai, Ibn Zaid bhi yehi kehte hain aur yehi zyada zahir murad hai kyunke is ke baad hi hai ke woh poochta hai qiyamat kab hogi, us ka ye sawal bhi bataur inkar ke hai yeh janta hai ke qiyamat ka aana muhal hai, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Wa yaqooloona mata hazal-wa'du in kuntum sadiqeena) (Yunus: 48), kehte hain ke agar tum sache ho to bata do ke qiyamat kab aayegi? Un se keh de ke us ka ek din muqarrar hai jis se na tum ek saat aage barh sakoge na peeche hat sakoge. Yahan bhi farmata hai ke jab aankhein pathra jayengi, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (La yartaddu ilaihim tarfuhum wa af'idatuhum hawa'un) (Ibrahim: 43), yaani palkein jhapkeni nahi balki raab-o-dahshat khauf-o-wahshat ke maare aankhein phaar phaar kar idhar udhar dekhte rahenge, barq ki doosri qiraat barq bhi hai, maani qareeb qareeb hain aur chand ki roshni bilkul jati rahegi aur sooraj chand jama kar diye jayenge yaani dono ko be-noor kar ke lapait liya jayega, jaise farmaya ayat (Izas-shamsu kuwwirat) (At-Takwir: 1). Hazrat Ibn Masood (R.A) ki qiraat mein (Wa jumi'a bainash-shamsi wal-qamari) hai, insan jab yeh pareshani shiddat-e-haul ghabrahat aur nizam-e-alam ki yeh khatarnak halat dekhega to bhaga jayega aur kahega ke jaye panah yaani bhagne ki jagah kahan hai? Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se jo milega ke koi panah nahi Rab ke samne aur us ke paas thehrne ke siwa koi chara-e-kar nahi, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Ma lakum mim malja'in yauma'izin wa la lakum min nakeerin) (Ash-Shura: 47) yaani aaj na to koi jaye panah hai na aisi jagah ke wahan ja kar tum anjan aur be-pehchan ban jao, aaj har shakhs ko us ke agle pichle naye purane chhote bare aamal se muttala kiya jayega, jaise farman hai ayat (Wa wajadu ma amilu hadiran) (Al-Kahf: 49) jo kiya tha, mojood payenge aur tera Rab kisi par zulm na karega. Insan apne aap ko ba-khoobi janta hai apne aamal ka khud aaina hai go inkar kare aur uzr-o-mazrat pesh karta phire, jaise farman hai ayat (Iqra' kitabaka kafa binafsikal-yauma alaika haseeba) (17. Bani (Israil: 14).

(Al-Isra: 14) Apna nama-e-amal khud parh le aur apne taeen aap hi jaanch le, iske kaan, ankh, paon aur digar aza hi is par shahadat dene kafi hain, lekin afsos ke yeh dusron ke aibon aur nuqsanon ko dekhta hai aur apne kire chunne se ghafil hai, kaha jata hai ke Taurat mein likha hua hai ae Ibn-e-Adam tu dusron ki ankhon ka to tinka dekhta hai aur apni ankh ka shahteer bhi tujhe dikhai nahi deta? Qayamat ke din chahe insan fazool bahane banayega aur jhooti dalelein dega bekar uzr paish karega magar ek bhi qabool na kiya jayega. Is ayat ke maani yeh bhi kiye gaye hain ke woh parde dalein. Ahl-e-Yaman parde ko uzr kehte hain, lekin sahi maani upar wale hain jaise aur jagah hai ke koi maqool uzr na pa kar apne shirk ka sar se inkar hi kar denge ke Allah ki qasam hum mushrik the hi nahi aur jagah hai ke قیامت ke din Allah ke samne bhi qasmein kha kha kar sacha hona chahenge jaise duniya mein tumhare samne un ki halat hai lekin Allah par to un ka jhoot zahir hai chahe kitna hi woh apne taeen kuch bhi samajhte rahein, gharz uzr mazrat unhein qayamat ke din kuch karamad na hoga, jaise aur jagah farmata hai ayat (Yauoma la yanfa'uz-zalimina ma'ziratuhum wa lahumul-la'natu wa lahum su'ud-dar 52) 40. (Ghafir: 52) Zalimon ko un ki mazrat kuch kaam na aayegi yeh to apne shirk ke sath apni tamam bad-aamaliyon ka bhi inkar kar denge lekin be-sood hoga.)

Bani (Israil: 14).

Nafs-e-Lawwamah ki tafseer mein Hadrat Hasan Basri (Rahimahullah) se marwi hai ke is se murad momin ka nafs hai, woh har waqt apne ta'een malamat hi karta rehta hai ke yun kyun keh diya? Yeh kyun kha liya? Yeh khayal dil mein kyun aaya? Haan, fasiq o fajir ghafil hota hai, use kya padi jo apne nafs ko roke.

Bani (Israil: 14).

Imam Ibn Jarir farmate hain yeh sab aqwal qareeb qareeb hain, matlab yeh hai ke woh nafs wala hai jo neki ki kami par, burai ke ho jaane par apne nafs ko malamat karta hai aur faut shuda par nadamat karta hai.

Phir farmata hai: Kya insan yeh soche hue hai ke hum qayamat ke din is ki haddiyon ke jama karne par qadir na honge? Yeh toh nihayat ghalat khayal hai, hum use mutafarriq jagah se jama kar ke dobara khada karenge aur is ki balisht balisht bana denge. Ibn Abbas waghera farmate hain, yaani hum qadir hain ke ise oont ya ghore ke talwe ki tarah bana denge. 

Imam Ibn Jarir farmate hain, yaani duniya mein bhi agar hum chahte ise aisa kar dete. Aayat ke lafzon se toh zahir yahi maloom hota hai ke (Qadirina) haal hai (Najma'u) se, yaani kya insan yeh guman karta hai ke hum is ki haddiyan jama na karenge? Haan haan, hum anqareeb jama karenge, dar'anhalike humein un ke jama karne ki qudrat hai, balke agar hum chahein toh jitna yeh tha is se bhi kuch zyada bana kar ise uthayenge, is ki ungliyon ke sire tak barabar kar ke paida karenge. Ibn Qutaibah aur Zajjaj ke qaul ke yahi ma'ni hain.

Phir farmata hai ke insan apne aage fisq-o-fujoor karna chahta hai yaani qadam ba qadam barh raha hai, umidein bandhe hue hai, kehta jata hai ke gunah kar to loon tauba bhi ho jayegi qiyamat ke din se jo us ke aage hai kufr karta hai, woh goya apne sar par sawar ho kar aage barh raha hai, har waqt yehi paya jata hai ke ek ek qadam apne nafs ko Allah ki masiyat ki taraf barhata jata hai magar jin par Rab ka raham hai, aksar salaf ka qaul is ayat ki tafseer mein yehi hai ke gunahon mein jaldi karta hai aur tauba mein takheer karta hai. Hazrat Ibn Abbas (R.A) farmate hain jo yaum-e-hisab ka munkar hai, Ibn Zaid bhi yehi kehte hain aur yehi zyada zahir murad hai kyunke is ke baad hi hai ke woh poochta hai qiyamat kab hogi, us ka ye sawal bhi bataur inkar ke hai yeh janta hai ke qiyamat ka aana muhal hai, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Wa yaqooloona mata hazal-wa'du in kuntum sadiqeena) (Yunus: 48), kehte hain ke agar tum sache ho to bata do ke qiyamat kab aayegi? Un se keh de ke us ka ek din muqarrar hai jis se na tum ek saat aage barh sakoge na peeche hat sakoge. Yahan bhi farmata hai ke jab aankhein pathra jayengi, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (La yartaddu ilaihim tarfuhum wa af'idatuhum hawa'un) (Ibrahim: 43), yaani palkein jhapkeni nahi balki raab-o-dahshat khauf-o-wahshat ke maare aankhein phaar phaar kar idhar udhar dekhte rahenge, barq ki doosri qiraat barq bhi hai, maani qareeb qareeb hain aur chand ki roshni bilkul jati rahegi aur sooraj chand jama kar diye jayenge yaani dono ko be-noor kar ke lapait liya jayega, jaise farmaya ayat (Izas-shamsu kuwwirat) (At-Takwir: 1). Hazrat Ibn Masood (R.A) ki qiraat mein (Wa jumi'a bainash-shamsi wal-qamari) hai, insan jab yeh pareshani shiddat-e-haul ghabrahat aur nizam-e-alam ki yeh khatarnak halat dekhega to bhaga jayega aur kahega ke jaye panah yaani bhagne ki jagah kahan hai? Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se jo milega ke koi panah nahi Rab ke samne aur us ke paas thehrne ke siwa koi chara-e-kar nahi, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Ma lakum mim malja'in yauma'izin wa la lakum min nakeerin) (Ash-Shura: 47) yaani aaj na to koi jaye panah hai na aisi jagah ke wahan ja kar tum anjan aur be-pehchan ban jao, aaj har shakhs ko us ke agle pichle naye purane chhote bare aamal se muttala kiya jayega, jaise farman hai ayat (Wa wajadu ma amilu hadiran) (Al-Kahf: 49) jo kiya tha, mojood payenge aur tera Rab kisi par zulm na karega. Insan apne aap ko ba-khoobi janta hai apne aamal ka khud aaina hai go inkar kare aur uzr-o-mazrat pesh karta phire, jaise farman hai ayat (Iqra' kitabaka kafa binafsikal-yauma alaika haseeba) (17. Bani (Israil: 14).

(Al-Isra: 14) Apna nama-e-amal khud parh le aur apne taeen aap hi jaanch le, iske kaan, ankh, paon aur digar aza hi is par shahadat dene kafi hain, lekin afsos ke yeh dusron ke aibon aur nuqsanon ko dekhta hai aur apne kire chunne se ghafil hai, kaha jata hai ke Taurat mein likha hua hai ae Ibn-e-Adam tu dusron ki ankhon ka to tinka dekhta hai aur apni ankh ka shahteer bhi tujhe dikhai nahi deta? Qayamat ke din chahe insan fazool bahane banayega aur jhooti dalelein dega bekar uzr paish karega magar ek bhi qabool na kiya jayega. Is ayat ke maani yeh bhi kiye gaye hain ke woh parde dalein. Ahl-e-Yaman parde ko uzr kehte hain, lekin sahi maani upar wale hain jaise aur jagah hai ke koi maqool uzr na pa kar apne shirk ka sar se inkar hi kar denge ke Allah ki qasam hum mushrik the hi nahi aur jagah hai ke قیامت ke din Allah ke samne bhi qasmein kha kha kar sacha hona chahenge jaise duniya mein tumhare samne un ki halat hai lekin Allah par to un ka jhoot zahir hai chahe kitna hi woh apne taeen kuch bhi samajhte rahein, gharz uzr mazrat unhein qayamat ke din kuch karamad na hoga, jaise aur jagah farmata hai ayat (Yauoma la yanfa'uz-zalimina ma'ziratuhum wa lahumul-la'natu wa lahum su'ud-dar 52) 40. (Ghafir: 52) Zalimon ko un ki mazrat kuch kaam na aayegi yeh to apne shirk ke sath apni tamam bad-aamaliyon ka bhi inkar kar denge lekin be-sood hoga.)

Hifz-e-Quran, Tilawat-o-Tafsir ka Zimmedar Allah Ta'ala

Yahan Allah Azza wa Jall apne Nabi ﷺ ko taleem deta hai ke farishte se wahi kis tarah hasil karein, An-Hazrat ﷺ us ko akhz karne mein bahut jaldi karte thay aur qirat mein farishte ke bilkul sath sath rehte thay, pas Allah Azza wa Jall hukam farmata hai ke jab farishta wahi le kar aaye aap sunte rahein, phir jis dar se aap aisa karte thay usi tarah us ka wazih karana aur tafsir aur bayan aap se karane ki zimmedari bhi hum hi par hai, pas pehli halat yaad karana, dusri tilawat karana, teesri tafsir, mazmun aur tauzeeh matlab karana teeno ki kafalat Allah Ta'ala ne apne zimme li, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Wa la ta'jal bil-qur'ani min qabli an yuqda ilaika wahyuhu wa qur-rabbi zidni ilma) (Ta-Ha: 114) yani jab tak tere paas wahi puri na aaye to parhne mein jaldi na kiya kar hum se dua mang ke mere Rab mere علم ko zyada karta rahe, phir farmata hai use tere seene mein jam karna aur use tujh se parhwana hamara zimma hai jab hum use parhein yaani hamara nazil karda farishta jab use tilawat kare to tu sun le jab wo parh chuke tab tu parh hamari meherbani se tujhe pura yaad hoga itna hi nahi balki hifz karane tilawat karane ke baad hum tujhe is ki ma'ni-o-matalib ta'yeen-o-tauzeeh ke sath samjha denge taake hamari asli murad aur saaf shariat se tu puri tarah aagah ho jaye, Musnad mein hai Huzoor ﷺ ko is se pehle wahi ko dil mein utarne ki sakht takleef hoti thi is dar ke mare ke kahin main bhool na jaun farishte ke sath sath parhte jate thay aur aap ke hont hilte jate thay chunache Hazrat Ibn Abbas rawi-e-hadith ne apne hont hila kar dikhaya ke is tarah aur un ke shagird Saeed ne bhi apne ustad ki tarah hila kar apne shagird ko dikhaye is par yeh ayat utri ke itni jaldi na karo aur hont na hilaao ise aap ke seene mein jama karna aur aap ki zuban se is ki tilawat karana hamare supurd hai jab hum use parhein to aap suniye aur chup rahiye Jibrail ke chale jane ke baad unhi ki tarah un ka parhaya hua parhna bhi hamare supurd hai, Bukhari-o-Muslim mein bhi yeh riwayat hai, Bukhari Sharif mein yeh bhi hai ke phir jab wahi utarti aap nazrein neechi kar lete aur jab wahi chali jati aap parhte, Ibn Abi Hatim mein bhi ba-riwayat Ibn Abbas yeh hadith marwi hai aur bahut se mufassireen salaf saleheen ne yahi farmaya hai yeh bhi marwi hai ke Huzoor ﷺ har waqt tilawat farmaya karte thay ke aisa na ho main bhool jaun is par yeh ayatein utrin, Hazrat Ibn Abbas aur Atiyyah Aufi farmate hain is ka bayan hum par hai yani halal haram ka wazih karna Hazrat Qatadah ka qaul bhi yahi hai.

Phir farman hota hai ki un kafiron ko qiyamat ke inkar, Allah ki pak Kitab ko na manne aur Allah ke azeem-ush-shan Rasool ﷺ ki itaat na karne par amada karne wali cheez hubb-e-dunya aur ghaflat-e-akhirat hai, halanki akhirat ka din badi ahmiyat wala din hai, us din bahut se log to woh honge jin ke chehre hashash bashash taru taza khush-o-kurram honge aur apne Rab ke deedar se musharraf ho rahe honge, jaise ki Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ki anqareeb tum apne Rab ko saf saf khulm khula apne samne dekhoge, bahut si sahih ahadees se mutawatir sanadon se jo aimma-e-hadees ne apni kitabon mein وارد ki hain sabit ho chuka hai ki iman wale apne Rab ke deedar se qiyamat ke din musharraf honge, in ahadees ko na to koi hata sake na in ka koi inkar kar sake. Sahih Bukhari o Sahih Muslim Sharif mein Hazrat Abu Saeed aur Hazrat Abu Hurairah رضي الله عنه se marwi hai ki logon ne pucha Ya RasoolAllah ﷺ kya hum apne Rab ko qiyamat ke din dekhenge? Aap ne farmaya suraj aur chand ko jabki asman saf be-abr ho dekhne mein tumhein koi muzahamat ya rukawat hoti hai? Unhone kaha nahi, Aap ne farmaya isi tarah tum Allah Ta'ala ko dekhoge, Bukhari o Muslim mein hai Hazrat Jareer se marwi hai ki Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya chodahween raat ke chand ko dekh rahe ho pas agar tum se ho sake toh suraj nikalne se pehle ki namaz (yaani Subh ki namaz) aur suraj doobne se pehle ki namaz (yaani Asr ki namaz) mein kisi tarah ki susti na karo, Hazrat Abu Moosa رضي الله عنه se unhi dono mubarak kitabon mein marwi hai ki RasoolAllah ﷺ ne farmaya do jannatein sone ki hain wahan ke bartan aur har cheez sone ki hai aur do jannatein chandi ki hain aur unke bartan aur har cheez chandi hi ki hai siwai kibria ki chadaron ke aur koi aad nahi. Yeh Jannat-e-Aden ka zikr hai, Sahih Muslim ki hadees mein hai ki jab jannati jannat mein pahunch jayenge toh Allah Ta'ala un se daryaft farmayega kuch chahte ho ki badha doon? Woh kahenge Ilahi Tu ne hamare chehre safaid noorani kar diye, humein jannat mein pahuncha diya, jahannam se bacha liya ab humein kis cheez ki zaroorat hai? Usi waqt hijab hata diye jayenge aur in ahl-e-jannat ki nigahein Jamal-e-Bari se munawwar hongi is mein unhein jo suroor-o-lazzat hasil hogi woh kisi cheez mein na hasil hogi sab se zyada mahboob unhein deedar-e-Bari hoga isi ko is ayat mein lafz (ziyadah) se tabeer kiya gaya hai phir Aap ne yeh ayat padhi: (Lillazeena ahsanoo al-husna wa ziyadatuw wala yarhaqu wujoohahum qatarunw wa la zillatun ulaika ashabul-jannati hum fiha khalidoon 26) 10.

(Yunus: 26) Yaani ehsan karne walon ko jannat bhi milegi aur deedar-e-Rab bhi, Sahih Muslim ki Hazrat Jabir wali riwayat mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala mominon par qiyamat ke maidan mein muskurata hua tajalli farmayega, pas maloom hua ke imandar qiyamat ke arsat mein aur jannaton mein deedar-e-Ilahi se musharraf kiye jayenge, Musnad Ahmad ki hadith mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain sab se halke darje ka jannati apne mulk aur apni malkiyat ko do hazaar saal dekhta rahega door aur nazdeek ki cheezein yaksan nigah mein hongi har taraf aur har jagah usi ki biwiyan aur khadim nazar ayenge aur aala darje ke jannati ek ek din mein do do martaba Allah Ta'ala ke buzurg chehre ko dekhenge, Tirmidhi Sharif mein bhi yeh hadith hai, yeh hadith bi-riwayat Hazrat Ibn Umar marfu'an bhi marwi hai, hamein dar hai ke agar is qism ki tamam hadeethein aur riwayatein aur un ke sanadein aur un ke mukhtalif alfaaz yahan jama karenge toh mazmoon bohat taweel hojayega bohat hi sahih aur hasan hadeethein bohat si Musnad aur Sunan ki kitabon mein marwi hain jin mein aksar hamari is tafsir mein mutafarriq muqamat par aabhi gayi hain, haan taufeeq Allah ke haath mein hai, Allah ka shukr hai ke is masla mein yaani Allah Ta'ala ka deedar mominon ko qiyamat ke din hone mein Sahaba, Tabi'in aur Salaf-e-Ummat ka ittefaq aur ijma hai aimma-e-Islam aur hudat-e-anam sab is par muttafiq hain, jo log is ki taweel karte hain aur kehte hain ke murad is se Allah Ta'ala ki ne'maton ko dekhna hai pas is ayat ka kya jawab hai jahan badkaron ki nisbat farmaya gaya hai ayat (Kallaa innahum 'an rabbihim yawma-izin lamahjuboon 15) (Al-Mutaffifin: 15) yaani fajir qiyamat ke din apne parwardigar se parde mein kardeye jayenge, Hazrat Imam Shafi'i farmate hain ke fajaron ke deedar-e-Ilahi se mehroom rehne ka saaf matlab yahi hai ke abrar yaani naik kaar log deedar-e-Ilahi se musharraf kiye jayenge aur mutawatir ahadith se sabit hochuka hai aur usi par is ayat ki rawangi-e-alfaaz saaf dalalat karti hai ke imandar deedar-e-bari se mahzouz honge, Hazrat Hasan farmate hain yeh chehre husn-o-khubi wale honge kyunke deedar-e-Rab par un ki nigahein parti hongi phir bhala yeh munawwar-o-haseen kyun na hon aur bohat se munh us din bigde hue honge bad-shakal ho rahe honge be-raunaq aur udaas honge, unhein yaqeen hoga ke hum par koi halakat aur Allah ki pakar ayi, abhi hamein jahannam mein jaane ka hukm hua, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Yawma tabyaddu wujoohun wa taswaddu wujoohun fa ammal-lazinaswaddat wujoohuhum akafartum ba'da imanikum fazooqul-azaba bima kuntum takforoon 106) (3. Ali 'Imran: 106) yaani us din ba'z chehre gore chitte khubsurat aur haseen honge aur ba'z kale munh wale honge aur jagah hai ayat (Wujoohun yawma-izin khashi'atun) (Al-Ghashiyah: 2)

(Al-Ghashiyah: 2), yaani Roz-e-Qayamat ke din bahut se chehre khauf-zada, dehshat aur dar wale, bad-ronaq aur zaleel honge jo amal karte rahe, takleef uthate rahe lekin aaj bhadakti hui aag mein ja ghuse. Phir farmaya ayat (Wujuhun yawma'izin na'imah) 88. (Al-Ghashiyah: 8), yaani ba'az chehre us din nematon wale, khush-o-khurram, chamkeele aur shadan-o-farhan bhi honge, jo apne guzishta aamal se khush honge aur buland-o-bala jannaton mein iqamat rakhte honge. Isi mazmoon ki aur bhi bahut si aayatein hain.

ka saaf matlab yahi hai ke abrar yaani naik kaar log deedar-e-Ilahi se musharraf kiye jayenge aur mutawatir ahadith se sabit hochuka hai aur usi par is ayat ki rawangi-e-alfaaz saaf dalalat karti hai ke imandar deedar-e-bari se mahzouz honge, Hazrat Hasan farmate hain yeh chehre husn-o-khubi wale honge kyunke deedar-e-Rab par un ki nigahein parti hongi phir bhala yeh munawwar-o-haseen kyun na hon aur bohat se munh us din bigde hue honge bad-shakal ho rahe honge be-raunaq aur udaas honge, unhein yaqeen hoga ke hum par koi halakat aur Allah ki pakar ayi, abhi hamein jahannam mein jaane ka hukm hua, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Yawma tabyaddu wujoohun wa taswaddu wujoohun fa ammal-lazinaswaddat wujoohuhum akafartum ba'da imanikum fazooqul-azaba bima kuntum takforoon 106) (3. Ali 'Imran: 106) yaani us din ba'z chehre gore chitte khubsurat aur haseen honge aur ba'z kale munh wale honge aur jagah hai ayat (Wujoohun yawma-izin khashi'atun) (Al-Ghashiyah: 2)

(Al-Ghashiyah: 2), yaani Roz-e-Qayamat ke din bahut se chehre khauf-zada, dehshat aur dar wale, bad-ronaq aur zaleel honge jo amal karte rahe, takleef uthate rahe lekin aaj bhadakti hui aag mein ja ghuse. Phir farmaya ayat (Wujuhun yawma'izin na'imah) 88. (Al-Ghashiyah: 8), yaani ba'az chehre us din nematon wale, khush-o-khurram, chamkeele aur shadan-o-farhan bhi honge, jo apne guzishta aamal se khush honge aur buland-o-bala jannaton mein iqamat rakhte honge. Isi mazmoon ki aur bhi bahut si aayatein hain.

Hifz-e-Quran, Tilawat-o-Tafsir ka Zimmedar Allah Ta'ala

Yahan Allah Azza wa Jall apne Nabi ﷺ ko taleem deta hai ke farishte se wahi kis tarah hasil karein, An-Hazrat ﷺ us ko akhz karne mein bahut jaldi karte thay aur qirat mein farishte ke bilkul sath sath rehte thay, pas Allah Azza wa Jall hukam farmata hai ke jab farishta wahi le kar aaye aap sunte rahein, phir jis dar se aap aisa karte thay usi tarah us ka wazih karana aur tafsir aur bayan aap se karane ki zimmedari bhi hum hi par hai, pas pehli halat yaad karana, dusri tilawat karana, teesri tafsir, mazmun aur tauzeeh matlab karana teeno ki kafalat Allah Ta'ala ne apne zimme li, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Wa la ta'jal bil-qur'ani min qabli an yuqda ilaika wahyuhu wa qur-rabbi zidni ilma) (Ta-Ha: 114) yani jab tak tere paas wahi puri na aaye to parhne mein jaldi na kiya kar hum se dua mang ke mere Rab mere علم ko zyada karta rahe, phir farmata hai use tere seene mein jam karna aur use tujh se parhwana hamara zimma hai jab hum use parhein yaani hamara nazil karda farishta jab use tilawat kare to tu sun le jab wo parh chuke tab tu parh hamari meherbani se tujhe pura yaad hoga itna hi nahi balki hifz karane tilawat karane ke baad hum tujhe is ki ma'ni-o-matalib ta'yeen-o-tauzeeh ke sath samjha denge taake hamari asli murad aur saaf shariat se tu puri tarah aagah ho jaye, Musnad mein hai Huzoor ﷺ ko is se pehle wahi ko dil mein utarne ki sakht takleef hoti thi is dar ke mare ke kahin main bhool na jaun farishte ke sath sath parhte jate thay aur aap ke hont hilte jate thay chunache Hazrat Ibn Abbas rawi-e-hadith ne apne hont hila kar dikhaya ke is tarah aur un ke shagird Saeed ne bhi apne ustad ki tarah hila kar apne shagird ko dikhaye is par yeh ayat utri ke itni jaldi na karo aur hont na hilaao ise aap ke seene mein jama karna aur aap ki zuban se is ki tilawat karana hamare supurd hai jab hum use parhein to aap suniye aur chup rahiye Jibrail ke chale jane ke baad unhi ki tarah un ka parhaya hua parhna bhi hamare supurd hai, Bukhari-o-Muslim mein bhi yeh riwayat hai, Bukhari Sharif mein yeh bhi hai ke phir jab wahi utarti aap nazrein neechi kar lete aur jab wahi chali jati aap parhte, Ibn Abi Hatim mein bhi ba-riwayat Ibn Abbas yeh hadith marwi hai aur bahut se mufassireen salaf saleheen ne yahi farmaya hai yeh bhi marwi hai ke Huzoor ﷺ har waqt tilawat farmaya karte thay ke aisa na ho main bhool jaun is par yeh ayatein utrin, Hazrat Ibn Abbas aur Atiyyah Aufi farmate hain is ka bayan hum par hai yani halal haram ka wazih karna Hazrat Qatadah ka qaul bhi yahi hai.

Phir farman hota hai ki un kafiron ko qiyamat ke inkar, Allah ki pak Kitab ko na manne aur Allah ke azeem-ush-shan Rasool ﷺ ki itaat na karne par amada karne wali cheez hubb-e-dunya aur ghaflat-e-akhirat hai, halanki akhirat ka din badi ahmiyat wala din hai, us din bahut se log to woh honge jin ke chehre hashash bashash taru taza khush-o-kurram honge aur apne Rab ke deedar se musharraf ho rahe honge, jaise ki Sahih Bukhari Sharif mein hai ki anqareeb tum apne Rab ko saf saf khulm khula apne samne dekhoge, bahut si sahih ahadees se mutawatir sanadon se jo aimma-e-hadees ne apni kitabon mein وارد ki hain sabit ho chuka hai ki iman wale apne Rab ke deedar se qiyamat ke din musharraf honge, in ahadees ko na to koi hata sake na in ka koi inkar kar sake. Sahih Bukhari o Sahih Muslim Sharif mein Hazrat Abu Saeed aur Hazrat Abu Hurairah رضي الله عنه se marwi hai ki logon ne pucha Ya RasoolAllah ﷺ kya hum apne Rab ko qiyamat ke din dekhenge? Aap ne farmaya suraj aur chand ko jabki asman saf be-abr ho dekhne mein tumhein koi muzahamat ya rukawat hoti hai? Unhone kaha nahi, Aap ne farmaya isi tarah tum Allah Ta'ala ko dekhoge, Bukhari o Muslim mein hai Hazrat Jareer se marwi hai ki Nabi ﷺ ne farmaya chodahween raat ke chand ko dekh rahe ho pas agar tum se ho sake toh suraj nikalne se pehle ki namaz (yaani Subh ki namaz) aur suraj doobne se pehle ki namaz (yaani Asr ki namaz) mein kisi tarah ki susti na karo, Hazrat Abu Moosa رضي الله عنه se unhi dono mubarak kitabon mein marwi hai ki RasoolAllah ﷺ ne farmaya do jannatein sone ki hain wahan ke bartan aur har cheez sone ki hai aur do jannatein chandi ki hain aur unke bartan aur har cheez chandi hi ki hai siwai kibria ki chadaron ke aur koi aad nahi. Yeh Jannat-e-Aden ka zikr hai, Sahih Muslim ki hadees mein hai ki jab jannati jannat mein pahunch jayenge toh Allah Ta'ala un se daryaft farmayega kuch chahte ho ki badha doon? Woh kahenge Ilahi Tu ne hamare chehre safaid noorani kar diye, humein jannat mein pahuncha diya, jahannam se bacha liya ab humein kis cheez ki zaroorat hai? Usi waqt hijab hata diye jayenge aur in ahl-e-jannat ki nigahein Jamal-e-Bari se munawwar hongi is mein unhein jo suroor-o-lazzat hasil hogi woh kisi cheez mein na hasil hogi sab se zyada mahboob unhein deedar-e-Bari hoga isi ko is ayat mein lafz (ziyadah) se tabeer kiya gaya hai phir Aap ne yeh ayat padhi: (Lillazeena ahsanoo al-husna wa ziyadatuw wala yarhaqu wujoohahum qatarunw wa la zillatun ulaika ashabul-jannati hum fiha khalidoon 26) 10.

(Yunus: 26) Yaani ehsan karne walon ko jannat bhi milegi aur deedar-e-Rab bhi, Sahih Muslim ki Hazrat Jabir wali riwayat mein hai ke Allah Ta'ala mominon par qiyamat ke maidan mein muskurata hua tajalli farmayega, pas maloom hua ke imandar qiyamat ke arsat mein aur jannaton mein deedar-e-Ilahi se musharraf kiye jayenge, Musnad Ahmad ki hadith mein hai Rasool Allah ﷺ farmate hain sab se halke darje ka jannati apne mulk aur apni malkiyat ko do hazaar saal dekhta rahega door aur nazdeek ki cheezein yaksan nigah mein hongi har taraf aur har jagah usi ki biwiyan aur khadim nazar ayenge aur aala darje ke jannati ek ek din mein do do martaba Allah Ta'ala ke buzurg chehre ko dekhenge, Tirmidhi Sharif mein bhi yeh hadith hai, yeh hadith bi-riwayat Hazrat Ibn Umar marfu'an bhi marwi hai, hamein dar hai ke agar is qism ki tamam hadeethein aur riwayatein aur un ke sanadein aur un ke mukhtalif alfaaz yahan jama karenge toh mazmoon bohat taweel hojayega bohat hi sahih aur hasan hadeethein bohat si Musnad aur Sunan ki kitabon mein marwi hain jin mein aksar hamari is tafsir mein mutafarriq muqamat par aabhi gayi hain, haan taufeeq Allah ke haath mein hai, Allah ka shukr hai ke is masla mein yaani Allah Ta'ala ka deedar mominon ko qiyamat ke din hone mein Sahaba, Tabi'in aur Salaf-e-Ummat ka ittefaq aur ijma hai aimma-e-Islam aur hudat-e-anam sab is par muttafiq hain, jo log is ki taweel karte hain aur kehte hain ke murad is se Allah Ta'ala ki ne'maton ko dekhna hai pas is ayat ka kya jawab hai jahan badkaron ki nisbat farmaya gaya hai ayat (Kallaa innahum 'an rabbihim yawma-izin lamahjuboon 15) (Al-Mutaffifin: 15) yaani fajir qiyamat ke din apne parwardigar se parde mein kardeye jayenge, Hazrat Imam Shafi'i farmate hain ke fajaron ke deedar-e-Ilahi se mehroom rehne ka saaf matlab yahi hai ke abrar yaani naik kaar log deedar-e-Ilahi se musharraf kiye jayenge aur mutawatir ahadith se sabit hochuka hai aur usi par is ayat ki rawangi-e-alfaaz saaf dalalat karti hai ke imandar deedar-e-bari se mahzouz honge, Hazrat Hasan farmate hain yeh chehre husn-o-khubi wale honge kyunke deedar-e-Rab par un ki nigahein parti hongi phir bhala yeh munawwar-o-haseen kyun na hon aur bohat se munh us din bigde hue honge bad-shakal ho rahe honge be-raunaq aur udaas honge, unhein yaqeen hoga ke hum par koi halakat aur Allah ki pakar ayi, abhi hamein jahannam mein jaane ka hukm hua, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Yawma tabyaddu wujoohun wa taswaddu wujoohun fa ammal-lazinaswaddat wujoohuhum akafartum ba'da imanikum fazooqul-azaba bima kuntum takforoon 106) (3. Ali 'Imran: 106) yaani us din ba'z chehre gore chitte khubsurat aur haseen honge aur ba'z kale munh wale honge aur jagah hai ayat (Wujoohun yawma-izin khashi'atun) (Al-Ghashiyah: 2)

(Al-Ghashiyah: 2), yaani Roz-e-Qayamat ke din bahut se chehre khauf-zada, dehshat aur dar wale, bad-ronaq aur zaleel honge jo amal karte rahe, takleef uthate rahe lekin aaj bhadakti hui aag mein ja ghuse. Phir farmaya ayat (Wujuhun yawma'izin na'imah) 88. (Al-Ghashiyah: 8), yaani ba'az chehre us din nematon wale, khush-o-khurram, chamkeele aur shadan-o-farhan bhi honge, jo apne guzishta aamal se khush honge aur buland-o-bala jannaton mein iqamat rakhte honge. Isi mazmoon ki aur bhi bahut si aayatein hain.

Jab hamari rooh halq tak pahunch jati hai aur us ke baad kya hota hai yahan maut ka aur sakraat ki kaifiyat ka bayan ho raha hai Allah Ta'ala hamein us waqt haq par sabit qadam rakhe. (Kalla) ko agar yahan daant ke ma'ane mein liya jaye toh yeh ma'ane honge ke "Aaye Ibn-e-Adam tu jo meri khabron ko jhutlata hai yeh durust nahi balki un ke muqaddamaat toh tu rozmarra khullam khula dekh raha hai" aur agar is lafz ko (Haqqa) ke ma'ane mein lein toh matlab aur zyada zahir hai yaani yeh baat yaqeeni hai ke jab teri rooh tere jism se nikalne lage aur tere nakhare tak pahunch jaye (Taraqi) jama hai (Tarquwa) ki un haddiyon ko kehte hain jo seene par aur mundhon ke darmiyan mein hain jise haans ki haddi kehte hain, jaise aur jagah hai (Falaula iza balagatil hulqum) (Al-Waqi'ah: 83) farmaya hai yaani jabke rooh halq tak pahunch jaye aur tum dekh rahe ho aur hum tum se bhi zyada us ke qareeb hain lekin tum nahi dekh sakte pas agar tum hukm-e-ilahi ke matahat nahi ho aur apne us qaul mein sachhe ho toh us rooh ko kyun nahi lota late? Is maqam par us hadith par bhi nazar daal li jaye jo Bishr bin Hajjaj ki riwayat se Surah Yasin ki tafsir mein guzar chuki hai, (Taraqi) jo jama hai (Tarquwa) ki un haddiyon ko kehte hain jo (Hulqum) ke qareeb hain us waqt haaye duhai hoti hai ke koi hai jo jhaar phoonk kare yaani kisi tabeeb waghera ke zariye shifa ho sakti hai? Aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke yeh farishton ka qaul hai yaani us rooh ko le kar kaun chadhega rahmat ke farishte ya azab ke? Aur pandli se pandli ke ragda khane ka ek matlab toh Hazrat Ibn Abbas waghera se yeh marwi hai ke duniya aur akhirat us par jama ho jati hai duniya ka aakhiri din hota hai aur akhirat ka pehla din hota hai jis se sakhti aur sakht ho jati hai magar jis par Rabb-e-Raheem ka rahm-o-karam ho, doosra matlab Hazrat Ikrimah se yeh marwi hai ke ek bahut bada ameer doosre bahut bade ameer se mil jata hai bala par bala aa jati hai, teesra matlab Hazrat Hasan Basri waghera se marwi hai ke khud marne wale ki be-qarari, shiddat-e-dard se paon par paon ka chadh jana murad hai. Pehle toh in pairon par chalta firta tha ab in mein jaan kahan?

Aur yeh bhi marwi hai ke kafan ke waqt pandli se pandli ka mil jana murad hai, chautha matlab Hazrat Dahhak se yeh bhi marwi hai ke do kaam do taraf jama hojate hain idhar to log us ke jism ko nehla dhula kar supurd-e-khak karne ko tayar hain idhar farishte us ki rooh le jane mein mashghool hain agar naik hai toh umda tayari aur dhoom ke sath agar bad hai toh nihayat hi burai aur badtar halat ke sath ab lautne, qarar pane, rehne sehne, pohch jane khich kar aur chal kar pohchne ki jagah Allah hi ki taraf hai rooh asman ki taraf charhai jati hai phir wahan se hukm hota hai ke usay zameen ki taraf wapas le jao maine un sab ko usi se paida kiya hai usi mein lota kar le jaunga aur phir usi se unhein dobara nikalunga, jaise ke Hazrat Bara' ki mutawwal hadis mein aya hai, yahi mazmoon aur jagah bayan hua hai ayat (Wa huwal-qahiru fauqa 'ibadihi wa yursilu 'alaykum hafazatan hatta iza ja'a ahadakumu-mawtu tawaffathu rusuluna wa hum la yu-farritun) (6:61), Woh apne bandon par ghalib hai woh tumhari hifazat ke liye tumhare pas farishte bhejta hai yahan tak ke tum mein se kisi ki maut ka waqt ajaye toh hamare bheje hue farishte usay faut kar lete hain aur woh koi qasoor nahi karte phir sab ke sab apne sachche Maula ki taraf lautaye jate hain yaqeen mano ke hukm usi ka chalta hai aur woh sab se jald hisab lene wala hai. Phir us kafir insan ka hal bayan ho raha hai jo apne dil aur aqeedah se haq ka jhutlane wala aur apne badan aur amal se haq se rogardani karne wala tha jis ka zahir batin barbad ho chuka tha aur koi bhalai us mein baqi nahi rahi thi, na woh Allah ki baaton ki dil se tasdeeq karta tha na jism se ibadat Allah baja lata tha yahan tak ke namaz ka bhi chor tha, han jhutlane aur munh marone mein be-bak tha aur apne is nakara amal par utrata aur phoolta huwa be-himati aur bad-amli ke sath apne walon mein ja milta tha, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Wa iza-inqalabu ila ahlihimunqalabu fakiheen) (83:31) yaani jab apne walon ki taraf lautte hain toh khoob baten banate huwe maze karte huwe khush khush jate hain aur jagah hai ayat (Innahu kana fi ahlihi masrooran) yani yeh apne gharane walon mein shadman tha aur samajh raha tha ke Allah ki taraf usay lotna hi nahi. Us ka yeh khayal mahz ghalat tha us ke Rab ki nigahen us par thin, phir usay Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala dhamkata hai aur dar sunata hai aur farmata hai kharabi ho tujhe Allah ke sath kufr kar ke phir utrata hai. Jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Zuq inna antal-'azizul-kareem) (44:49) yaani Qayamat ke din kafir se batur dant aur haqarat ke kaha jayega ke le ab maza chakh tu to bari izzat aur buzurgi wala tha aur farman hai ayat (Kulu wa tamatta'u qalilan innakum mujrimun) (77:46).

(Al-Mursalat: 46) Kuch kha pi lo akhir to badkar gunahgar ho aur jagah hai ayat (FA'BUDU MA SHI'TUM MIN DUNIHII QUL INNAL-KHASIRINALLADHINA KHASIRU ANFUSAHUM WA AHLIYAHUM YAWMAL-QIYAMATI ALA ZALIKA HUWAL-KHUSRANUL-MUBIN) 39. (Az-Zumar: 15) jao Allah ke siva jis ki chaho ibadat karo vagaira vagaira gharz yeh hai ki in tamam jagahon mein yeh ahkam bataur dant dapt ke hain. Hazrat Sa'eed bin Jubair se jab yeh ayat (AWLA LAKA FA-AWLA) 75. (Al-Qiyamah: 34), ki babat pucha gaya to Aap ne farmaya Rasool-e-Maqbool ﷺ ne yeh Abu Jahl ko farmaya tha phir Quran mein bhi yehi alfaz nazil hue, Hazrat Ibn Abbas se bhi isi ke qareeb qareeb Nasai mein maujood hai, Ibn Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Qatadah ki riwayat hai ki Huzoor ﷺ ke is farman par us dushman-e-Rab ne kaha ki kya tu mujhe dhamkata hai? Allah ki qasam tu aur tera Rab mera kuch nahi bigad sakte, in dono pahadiyon ke darmiyan chalne walon mein sab se zyada zi-izzat main hoon. Kya insan yeh samajhta hai ki use yunhi chhor diya jayega? Use koi hukum aur kisi cheez ki mamanat na ki jayegi? Aisa hargiz nahi balki duniya mein use hukum-o-mamanat aur akhirat mein apne apne aamal ke bamujab jaza-o-saza zaroor milegi, maqsad yahan par Qiyamat ka isbat aur munkirin-e-Qiyamat ka radd hai, isi liye daleel ke taur par kaha jata hai ki insan darasal nutfah ki shakl mein be-jan-o-be-buniyaad tha pani ka zaleel qatra tha jo peeth se rahm mein aya phir khoon ki phatki bani, phir gosht ka lothra hua, phir Allah Ta'ala ne shakl-o-soorat de kar rooh phonki aur salim a'za wala insan bana kar mard ya aurat ki soorat mein paida kiya. Kya Allah jis ne nutfah-e-zaeef ko aisa sahih-ul-qamat qawi insan bana diya woh is baat par qadir nahi ki use fana kar ke phir dobara paida kar karde? Yaqinan pehli martaba ka paida karne wala dobara banane par bohat zyada aur bataur-e-awla qadir hai, ya kam az kam utna hi jitna pehli martaba tha. Jaise farmaya (WA HUWAL-LADHI YABDA'UL-KHALQA THUMMA YU'IDUHU WA HUWA AHWANU 'ALAYHI) 30. (Ar-Rum: 27) Us ne ibtida paida kiya wahi phir lautayega aur woh is par bohat zyada asan hai.

Is ayat ke matlab mein bhi do qaul hain, lekin pehla qaul hi zyada mashhoor hai jaise ke Surah Room ki tafseer mein is ka bayan aur taqreer guzar chuki Wallahu A'lam, Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke ek Sahabi R.A apni chhat par ba-awaz-e-buland Quran Shareef parh rahe thay jab is surat ki aakhri ayat ki tilawat ki toh farmaya (Subhanakal-Lahumma qabli) yaani Aye Allah tu paak hai aur beshak qadir hai, logon ne is kehne ka baa'is poocha toh farmaya maine Rasool Allah ﷺ ko is ayat ka yehi jawab dete hue suna hai Abu Dawood mein bhi yeh hadees hai, lekin dono kitabon mein us Sahabi ka naam nahi go yeh naam na hona muzir nahi, Abu Dawood ki aur hadees mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya jo shakhs tum mein se Surah Wat-Tin ki aakhri ayat (A Laisal-Lahu bi-ahkamil-hakimeen) (At-Tin: 8) parhe woh (Bala wa ana ala zalika minash-shahideen) kahe yaani haan aur main bhi is par gawah hoon aur jo shakhs Surah Al-Qiyamah ki aakhri ayat (A laisa zalika bi-qadirin ala an yuhyil-mawta) (Al-Qiyamah: 40) parhe toh woh kahe (Bala) aur jo shakhs Surah Al-Mursalat ki aakhri ayat (Fa bi-ayyi hadeesin ba'da hu yu'minoon) (Al-Mursalat: 50) parhe woh (Amanna billah) kahe yeh hadees Musnad Ahmad aur Tirmidhi mein bhi hai, Ibn Jareer mein Hazrat Qatadah se marwi hai ke Nabi ﷺ is aakhri ayat ke baad farmate (Subhanaka wa bala) Hazrat Ibn Abbas se is ayat ke jawab mein yeh kehna Ibn Abi Hatim mein marwi hai. Surah Qiyamah ki tafseer Alhamdulillah khatam hui.

Jab hamari rooh halq tak pahunch jati hai aur us ke baad kya hota hai yahan maut ka aur sakraat ki kaifiyat ka bayan ho raha hai Allah Ta'ala hamein us waqt haq par sabit qadam rakhe. (Kalla) ko agar yahan daant ke ma'ane mein liya jaye toh yeh ma'ane honge ke "Aaye Ibn-e-Adam tu jo meri khabron ko jhutlata hai yeh durust nahi balki un ke muqaddamaat toh tu rozmarra khullam khula dekh raha hai" aur agar is lafz ko (Haqqa) ke ma'ane mein lein toh matlab aur zyada zahir hai yaani yeh baat yaqeeni hai ke jab teri rooh tere jism se nikalne lage aur tere nakhare tak pahunch jaye (Taraqi) jama hai (Tarquwa) ki un haddiyon ko kehte hain jo seene par aur mundhon ke darmiyan mein hain jise haans ki haddi kehte hain, jaise aur jagah hai (Falaula iza balagatil hulqum) (Al-Waqi'ah: 83) farmaya hai yaani jabke rooh halq tak pahunch jaye aur tum dekh rahe ho aur hum tum se bhi zyada us ke qareeb hain lekin tum nahi dekh sakte pas agar tum hukm-e-ilahi ke matahat nahi ho aur apne us qaul mein sachhe ho toh us rooh ko kyun nahi lota late? Is maqam par us hadith par bhi nazar daal li jaye jo Bishr bin Hajjaj ki riwayat se Surah Yasin ki tafsir mein guzar chuki hai, (Taraqi) jo jama hai (Tarquwa) ki un haddiyon ko kehte hain jo (Hulqum) ke qareeb hain us waqt haaye duhai hoti hai ke koi hai jo jhaar phoonk kare yaani kisi tabeeb waghera ke zariye shifa ho sakti hai? Aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke yeh farishton ka qaul hai yaani us rooh ko le kar kaun chadhega rahmat ke farishte ya azab ke? Aur pandli se pandli ke ragda khane ka ek matlab toh Hazrat Ibn Abbas waghera se yeh marwi hai ke duniya aur akhirat us par jama ho jati hai duniya ka aakhiri din hota hai aur akhirat ka pehla din hota hai jis se sakhti aur sakht ho jati hai magar jis par Rabb-e-Raheem ka rahm-o-karam ho, doosra matlab Hazrat Ikrimah se yeh marwi hai ke ek bahut bada ameer doosre bahut bade ameer se mil jata hai bala par bala aa jati hai, teesra matlab Hazrat Hasan Basri waghera se marwi hai ke khud marne wale ki be-qarari, shiddat-e-dard se paon par paon ka chadh jana murad hai. Pehle toh in pairon par chalta firta tha ab in mein jaan kahan?

Aur yeh bhi marwi hai ke kafan ke waqt pandli se pandli ka mil jana murad hai, chautha matlab Hazrat Dahhak se yeh bhi marwi hai ke do kaam do taraf jama hojate hain idhar to log us ke jism ko nehla dhula kar supurd-e-khak karne ko tayar hain idhar farishte us ki rooh le jane mein mashghool hain agar naik hai toh umda tayari aur dhoom ke sath agar bad hai toh nihayat hi burai aur badtar halat ke sath ab lautne, qarar pane, rehne sehne, pohch jane khich kar aur chal kar pohchne ki jagah Allah hi ki taraf hai rooh asman ki taraf charhai jati hai phir wahan se hukm hota hai ke usay zameen ki taraf wapas le jao maine un sab ko usi se paida kiya hai usi mein lota kar le jaunga aur phir usi se unhein dobara nikalunga, jaise ke Hazrat Bara' ki mutawwal hadis mein aya hai, yahi mazmoon aur jagah bayan hua hai ayat (Wa huwal-qahiru fauqa 'ibadihi wa yursilu 'alaykum hafazatan hatta iza ja'a ahadakumu-mawtu tawaffathu rusuluna wa hum la yu-farritun) (6:61), Woh apne bandon par ghalib hai woh tumhari hifazat ke liye tumhare pas farishte bhejta hai yahan tak ke tum mein se kisi ki maut ka waqt ajaye toh hamare bheje hue farishte usay faut kar lete hain aur woh koi qasoor nahi karte phir sab ke sab apne sachche Maula ki taraf lautaye jate hain yaqeen mano ke hukm usi ka chalta hai aur woh sab se jald hisab lene wala hai. Phir us kafir insan ka hal bayan ho raha hai jo apne dil aur aqeedah se haq ka jhutlane wala aur apne badan aur amal se haq se rogardani karne wala tha jis ka zahir batin barbad ho chuka tha aur koi bhalai us mein baqi nahi rahi thi, na woh Allah ki baaton ki dil se tasdeeq karta tha na jism se ibadat Allah baja lata tha yahan tak ke namaz ka bhi chor tha, han jhutlane aur munh marone mein be-bak tha aur apne is nakara amal par utrata aur phoolta huwa be-himati aur bad-amli ke sath apne walon mein ja milta tha, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Wa iza-inqalabu ila ahlihimunqalabu fakiheen) (83:31) yaani jab apne walon ki taraf lautte hain toh khoob baten banate huwe maze karte huwe khush khush jate hain aur jagah hai ayat (Innahu kana fi ahlihi masrooran) yani yeh apne gharane walon mein shadman tha aur samajh raha tha ke Allah ki taraf usay lotna hi nahi. Us ka yeh khayal mahz ghalat tha us ke Rab ki nigahen us par thin, phir usay Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala dhamkata hai aur dar sunata hai aur farmata hai kharabi ho tujhe Allah ke sath kufr kar ke phir utrata hai. Jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Zuq inna antal-'azizul-kareem) (44:49) yaani Qayamat ke din kafir se batur dant aur haqarat ke kaha jayega ke le ab maza chakh tu to bari izzat aur buzurgi wala tha aur farman hai ayat (Kulu wa tamatta'u qalilan innakum mujrimun) (77:46).

(Al-Mursalat: 46) Kuch kha pi lo akhir to badkar gunahgar ho aur jagah hai ayat (FA'BUDU MA SHI'TUM MIN DUNIHII QUL INNAL-KHASIRINALLADHINA KHASIRU ANFUSAHUM WA AHLIYAHUM YAWMAL-QIYAMATI ALA ZALIKA HUWAL-KHUSRANUL-MUBIN) 39. (Az-Zumar: 15) jao Allah ke siva jis ki chaho ibadat karo vagaira vagaira gharz yeh hai ki in tamam jagahon mein yeh ahkam bataur dant dapt ke hain. Hazrat Sa'eed bin Jubair se jab yeh ayat (AWLA LAKA FA-AWLA) 75. (Al-Qiyamah: 34), ki babat pucha gaya to Aap ne farmaya Rasool-e-Maqbool ﷺ ne yeh Abu Jahl ko farmaya tha phir Quran mein bhi yehi alfaz nazil hue, Hazrat Ibn Abbas se bhi isi ke qareeb qareeb Nasai mein maujood hai, Ibn Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Qatadah ki riwayat hai ki Huzoor ﷺ ke is farman par us dushman-e-Rab ne kaha ki kya tu mujhe dhamkata hai? Allah ki qasam tu aur tera Rab mera kuch nahi bigad sakte, in dono pahadiyon ke darmiyan chalne walon mein sab se zyada zi-izzat main hoon. Kya insan yeh samajhta hai ki use yunhi chhor diya jayega? Use koi hukum aur kisi cheez ki mamanat na ki jayegi? Aisa hargiz nahi balki duniya mein use hukum-o-mamanat aur akhirat mein apne apne aamal ke bamujab jaza-o-saza zaroor milegi, maqsad yahan par Qiyamat ka isbat aur munkirin-e-Qiyamat ka radd hai, isi liye daleel ke taur par kaha jata hai ki insan darasal nutfah ki shakl mein be-jan-o-be-buniyaad tha pani ka zaleel qatra tha jo peeth se rahm mein aya phir khoon ki phatki bani, phir gosht ka lothra hua, phir Allah Ta'ala ne shakl-o-soorat de kar rooh phonki aur salim a'za wala insan bana kar mard ya aurat ki soorat mein paida kiya. Kya Allah jis ne nutfah-e-zaeef ko aisa sahih-ul-qamat qawi insan bana diya woh is baat par qadir nahi ki use fana kar ke phir dobara paida kar karde? Yaqinan pehli martaba ka paida karne wala dobara banane par bohat zyada aur bataur-e-awla qadir hai, ya kam az kam utna hi jitna pehli martaba tha. Jaise farmaya (WA HUWAL-LADHI YABDA'UL-KHALQA THUMMA YU'IDUHU WA HUWA AHWANU 'ALAYHI) 30. (Ar-Rum: 27) Us ne ibtida paida kiya wahi phir lautayega aur woh is par bohat zyada asan hai.

Is ayat ke matlab mein bhi do qaul hain, lekin pehla qaul hi zyada mashhoor hai jaise ke Surah Room ki tafseer mein is ka bayan aur taqreer guzar chuki Wallahu A'lam, Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke ek Sahabi R.A apni chhat par ba-awaz-e-buland Quran Shareef parh rahe thay jab is surat ki aakhri ayat ki tilawat ki toh farmaya (Subhanakal-Lahumma qabli) yaani Aye Allah tu paak hai aur beshak qadir hai, logon ne is kehne ka baa'is poocha toh farmaya maine Rasool Allah ﷺ ko is ayat ka yehi jawab dete hue suna hai Abu Dawood mein bhi yeh hadees hai, lekin dono kitabon mein us Sahabi ka naam nahi go yeh naam na hona muzir nahi, Abu Dawood ki aur hadees mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya jo shakhs tum mein se Surah Wat-Tin ki aakhri ayat (A Laisal-Lahu bi-ahkamil-hakimeen) (At-Tin: 8) parhe woh (Bala wa ana ala zalika minash-shahideen) kahe yaani haan aur main bhi is par gawah hoon aur jo shakhs Surah Al-Qiyamah ki aakhri ayat (A laisa zalika bi-qadirin ala an yuhyil-mawta) (Al-Qiyamah: 40) parhe toh woh kahe (Bala) aur jo shakhs Surah Al-Mursalat ki aakhri ayat (Fa bi-ayyi hadeesin ba'da hu yu'minoon) (Al-Mursalat: 50) parhe woh (Amanna billah) kahe yeh hadees Musnad Ahmad aur Tirmidhi mein bhi hai, Ibn Jareer mein Hazrat Qatadah se marwi hai ke Nabi ﷺ is aakhri ayat ke baad farmate (Subhanaka wa bala) Hazrat Ibn Abbas se is ayat ke jawab mein yeh kehna Ibn Abi Hatim mein marwi hai. Surah Qiyamah ki tafseer Alhamdulillah khatam hui.

Phir us kafir insan ka hal bayan ho raha hai jo apne dil aur aqeedah se haq ka jhutlane wala aur apne badan aur amal se haq se rogardani karne wala tha jis ka zahir batin barbad ho chuka tha aur koi bhalai us mein baqi nahi rahi thi, na woh Allah ki baaton ki dil se tasdeeq karta tha na jism se ibadat Allah baja lata tha yahan tak ke namaz ka bhi chor tha, han jhutlane aur munh marone mein be-bak tha aur apne is nakara amal par utrata aur phoolta huwa be-himati aur bad-amli ke sath apne walon mein ja milta tha, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Wa iza-inqalabu ila ahlihimunqalabu fakiheen) (83:31) yaani jab apne walon ki taraf lautte hain toh khoob baten banate huwe maze karte huwe khush khush jate hain aur jagah hai ayat (Innahu kana fi ahlihi masrooran) yani yeh apne gharane walon mein shadman tha aur samajh raha tha ke Allah ki taraf usay lotna hi nahi. Us ka yeh khayal mahz ghalat tha us ke Rab ki nigahen us par thin, phir usay Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala dhamkata hai aur dar sunata hai aur farmata hai kharabi ho tujhe Allah ke sath kufr kar ke phir utrata hai. Jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Zuq inna antal-'azizul-kareem) (44:49) yaani Qayamat ke din kafir se batur dant aur haqarat ke kaha jayega ke le ab maza chakh tu to bari izzat aur buzurgi wala tha aur farman hai ayat (Kulu wa tamatta'u qalilan innakum mujrimun) (77:46).

(Al-Mursalat: 46) Kuch kha pi lo akhir to badkar gunahgar ho aur jagah hai ayat (FA'BUDU MA SHI'TUM MIN DUNIHII QUL INNAL-KHASIRINALLADHINA KHASIRU ANFUSAHUM WA AHLIYAHUM YAWMAL-QIYAMATI ALA ZALIKA HUWAL-KHUSRANUL-MUBIN) 39. (Az-Zumar: 15) jao Allah ke siva jis ki chaho ibadat karo vagaira vagaira gharz yeh hai ki in tamam jagahon mein yeh ahkam bataur dant dapt ke hain. Hazrat Sa'eed bin Jubair se jab yeh ayat (AWLA LAKA FA-AWLA) 75. (Al-Qiyamah: 34), ki babat pucha gaya to Aap ne farmaya Rasool-e-Maqbool ﷺ ne yeh Abu Jahl ko farmaya tha phir Quran mein bhi yehi alfaz nazil hue, Hazrat Ibn Abbas se bhi isi ke qareeb qareeb Nasai mein maujood hai, Ibn Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Qatadah ki riwayat hai ki Huzoor ﷺ ke is farman par us dushman-e-Rab ne kaha ki kya tu mujhe dhamkata hai? Allah ki qasam tu aur tera Rab mera kuch nahi bigad sakte, in dono pahadiyon ke darmiyan chalne walon mein sab se zyada zi-izzat main hoon. Kya insan yeh samajhta hai ki use yunhi chhor diya jayega? Use koi hukum aur kisi cheez ki mamanat na ki jayegi? Aisa hargiz nahi balki duniya mein use hukum-o-mamanat aur akhirat mein apne apne aamal ke bamujab jaza-o-saza zaroor milegi, maqsad yahan par Qiyamat ka isbat aur munkirin-e-Qiyamat ka radd hai, isi liye daleel ke taur par kaha jata hai ki insan darasal nutfah ki shakl mein be-jan-o-be-buniyaad tha pani ka zaleel qatra tha jo peeth se rahm mein aya phir khoon ki phatki bani, phir gosht ka lothra hua, phir Allah Ta'ala ne shakl-o-soorat de kar rooh phonki aur salim a'za wala insan bana kar mard ya aurat ki soorat mein paida kiya. Kya Allah jis ne nutfah-e-zaeef ko aisa sahih-ul-qamat qawi insan bana diya woh is baat par qadir nahi ki use fana kar ke phir dobara paida kar karde? Yaqinan pehli martaba ka paida karne wala dobara banane par bohat zyada aur bataur-e-awla qadir hai, ya kam az kam utna hi jitna pehli martaba tha. Jaise farmaya (WA HUWAL-LADHI YABDA'UL-KHALQA THUMMA YU'IDUHU WA HUWA AHWANU 'ALAYHI) 30. (Ar-Rum: 27) Us ne ibtida paida kiya wahi phir lautayega aur woh is par bohat zyada asan hai.

Is ayat ke matlab mein bhi do qaul hain, lekin pehla qaul hi zyada mashhoor hai jaise ke Surah Room ki tafseer mein is ka bayan aur taqreer guzar chuki Wallahu A'lam, Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke ek Sahabi R.A apni chhat par ba-awaz-e-buland Quran Shareef parh rahe thay jab is surat ki aakhri ayat ki tilawat ki toh farmaya (Subhanakal-Lahumma qabli) yaani Aye Allah tu paak hai aur beshak qadir hai, logon ne is kehne ka baa'is poocha toh farmaya maine Rasool Allah ﷺ ko is ayat ka yehi jawab dete hue suna hai Abu Dawood mein bhi yeh hadees hai, lekin dono kitabon mein us Sahabi ka naam nahi go yeh naam na hona muzir nahi, Abu Dawood ki aur hadees mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya jo shakhs tum mein se Surah Wat-Tin ki aakhri ayat (A Laisal-Lahu bi-ahkamil-hakimeen) (At-Tin: 8) parhe woh (Bala wa ana ala zalika minash-shahideen) kahe yaani haan aur main bhi is par gawah hoon aur jo shakhs Surah Al-Qiyamah ki aakhri ayat (A laisa zalika bi-qadirin ala an yuhyil-mawta) (Al-Qiyamah: 40) parhe toh woh kahe (Bala) aur jo shakhs Surah Al-Mursalat ki aakhri ayat (Fa bi-ayyi hadeesin ba'da hu yu'minoon) (Al-Mursalat: 50) parhe woh (Amanna billah) kahe yeh hadees Musnad Ahmad aur Tirmidhi mein bhi hai, Ibn Jareer mein Hazrat Qatadah se marwi hai ke Nabi ﷺ is aakhri ayat ke baad farmate (Subhanaka wa bala) Hazrat Ibn Abbas se is ayat ke jawab mein yeh kehna Ibn Abi Hatim mein marwi hai. Surah Qiyamah ki tafseer Alhamdulillah khatam hui.

(Al-Qiyamah: 34), ki babat pucha gaya to Aap ne farmaya Rasool-e-Maqbool ﷺ ne yeh Abu Jahl ko farmaya tha phir Quran mein bhi yehi alfaz nazil hue, Hazrat Ibn Abbas se bhi isi ke qareeb qareeb Nasai mein maujood hai, Ibn Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Qatadah ki riwayat hai ki Huzoor ﷺ ke is farman par us dushman-e-Rab ne kaha ki kya tu mujhe dhamkata hai? Allah ki qasam tu aur tera Rab mera kuch nahi bigad sakte, in dono pahadiyon ke darmiyan chalne walon mein sab se zyada zi-izzat main hoon. Kya insan yeh samajhta hai ki use yunhi chhor diya jayega? Use koi hukum aur kisi cheez ki mamanat na ki jayegi? Aisa hargiz nahi balki duniya mein use hukum-o-mamanat aur akhirat mein apne apne aamal ke bamujab jaza-o-saza zaroor milegi, maqsad yahan par Qiyamat ka isbat aur munkirin-e-Qiyamat ka radd hai, isi liye daleel ke taur par kaha jata hai ki insan darasal nutfah ki shakl mein be-jan-o-be-buniyaad tha pani ka zaleel qatra tha jo peeth se rahm mein aya phir khoon ki phatki bani, phir gosht ka lothra hua, phir Allah Ta'ala ne shakl-o-soorat de kar rooh phonki aur salim a'za wala insan bana kar mard ya aurat ki soorat mein paida kiya. Kya Allah jis ne nutfah-e-zaeef ko aisa sahih-ul-qamat qawi insan bana diya woh is baat par qadir nahi ki use fana kar ke phir dobara paida kar karde? Yaqinan pehli martaba ka paida karne wala dobara banane par bohat zyada aur bataur-e-awla qadir hai, ya kam az kam utna hi jitna pehli martaba tha. Jaise farmaya (WA HUWAL-LADHI YABDA'UL-KHALQA THUMMA YU'IDUHU WA HUWA AHWANU 'ALAYHI) 30. (Ar-Rum: 27) Us ne ibtida paida kiya wahi phir lautayega aur woh is par bohat zyada asan hai.

Is ayat ke matlab mein bhi do qaul hain, lekin pehla qaul hi zyada mashhoor hai jaise ke Surah Room ki tafseer mein is ka bayan aur taqreer guzar chuki Wallahu A'lam, Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke ek Sahabi R.A apni chhat par ba-awaz-e-buland Quran Shareef parh rahe thay jab is surat ki aakhri ayat ki tilawat ki toh farmaya (Subhanakal-Lahumma qabli) yaani Aye Allah tu paak hai aur beshak qadir hai, logon ne is kehne ka baa'is poocha toh farmaya maine Rasool Allah ﷺ ko is ayat ka yehi jawab dete hue suna hai Abu Dawood mein bhi yeh hadees hai, lekin dono kitabon mein us Sahabi ka naam nahi go yeh naam na hona muzir nahi, Abu Dawood ki aur hadees mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya jo shakhs tum mein se Surah Wat-Tin ki aakhri ayat (A Laisal-Lahu bi-ahkamil-hakimeen) (At-Tin: 8) parhe woh (Bala wa ana ala zalika minash-shahideen) kahe yaani haan aur main bhi is par gawah hoon aur jo shakhs Surah Al-Qiyamah ki aakhri ayat (A laisa zalika bi-qadirin ala an yuhyil-mawta) (Al-Qiyamah: 40) parhe toh woh kahe (Bala) aur jo shakhs Surah Al-Mursalat ki aakhri ayat (Fa bi-ayyi hadeesin ba'da hu yu'minoon) (Al-Mursalat: 50) parhe woh (Amanna billah) kahe yeh hadees Musnad Ahmad aur Tirmidhi mein bhi hai, Ibn Jareer mein Hazrat Qatadah se marwi hai ke Nabi ﷺ is aakhri ayat ke baad farmate (Subhanaka wa bala) Hazrat Ibn Abbas se is ayat ke jawab mein yeh kehna Ibn Abi Hatim mein marwi hai. Surah Qiyamah ki tafseer Alhamdulillah khatam hui.

Jab hamari rooh halq tak pahunch jati hai aur us ke baad kya hota hai yahan maut ka aur sakraat ki kaifiyat ka bayan ho raha hai Allah Ta'ala hamein us waqt haq par sabit qadam rakhe. (Kalla) ko agar yahan daant ke ma'ane mein liya jaye toh yeh ma'ane honge ke "Aaye Ibn-e-Adam tu jo meri khabron ko jhutlata hai yeh durust nahi balki un ke muqaddamaat toh tu rozmarra khullam khula dekh raha hai" aur agar is lafz ko (Haqqa) ke ma'ane mein lein toh matlab aur zyada zahir hai yaani yeh baat yaqeeni hai ke jab teri rooh tere jism se nikalne lage aur tere nakhare tak pahunch jaye (Taraqi) jama hai (Tarquwa) ki un haddiyon ko kehte hain jo seene par aur mundhon ke darmiyan mein hain jise haans ki haddi kehte hain, jaise aur jagah hai (Falaula iza balagatil hulqum) (Al-Waqi'ah: 83) farmaya hai yaani jabke rooh halq tak pahunch jaye aur tum dekh rahe ho aur hum tum se bhi zyada us ke qareeb hain lekin tum nahi dekh sakte pas agar tum hukm-e-ilahi ke matahat nahi ho aur apne us qaul mein sachhe ho toh us rooh ko kyun nahi lota late? Is maqam par us hadith par bhi nazar daal li jaye jo Bishr bin Hajjaj ki riwayat se Surah Yasin ki tafsir mein guzar chuki hai, (Taraqi) jo jama hai (Tarquwa) ki un haddiyon ko kehte hain jo (Hulqum) ke qareeb hain us waqt haaye duhai hoti hai ke koi hai jo jhaar phoonk kare yaani kisi tabeeb waghera ke zariye shifa ho sakti hai? Aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke yeh farishton ka qaul hai yaani us rooh ko le kar kaun chadhega rahmat ke farishte ya azab ke? Aur pandli se pandli ke ragda khane ka ek matlab toh Hazrat Ibn Abbas waghera se yeh marwi hai ke duniya aur akhirat us par jama ho jati hai duniya ka aakhiri din hota hai aur akhirat ka pehla din hota hai jis se sakhti aur sakht ho jati hai magar jis par Rabb-e-Raheem ka rahm-o-karam ho, doosra matlab Hazrat Ikrimah se yeh marwi hai ke ek bahut bada ameer doosre bahut bade ameer se mil jata hai bala par bala aa jati hai, teesra matlab Hazrat Hasan Basri waghera se marwi hai ke khud marne wale ki be-qarari, shiddat-e-dard se paon par paon ka chadh jana murad hai. Pehle toh in pairon par chalta firta tha ab in mein jaan kahan?

Aur yeh bhi marwi hai ke kafan ke waqt pandli se pandli ka mil jana murad hai, chautha matlab Hazrat Dahhak se yeh bhi marwi hai ke do kaam do taraf jama hojate hain idhar to log us ke jism ko nehla dhula kar supurd-e-khak karne ko tayar hain idhar farishte us ki rooh le jane mein mashghool hain agar naik hai toh umda tayari aur dhoom ke sath agar bad hai toh nihayat hi burai aur badtar halat ke sath ab lautne, qarar pane, rehne sehne, pohch jane khich kar aur chal kar pohchne ki jagah Allah hi ki taraf hai rooh asman ki taraf charhai jati hai phir wahan se hukm hota hai ke usay zameen ki taraf wapas le jao maine un sab ko usi se paida kiya hai usi mein lota kar le jaunga aur phir usi se unhein dobara nikalunga, jaise ke Hazrat Bara' ki mutawwal hadis mein aya hai, yahi mazmoon aur jagah bayan hua hai ayat (Wa huwal-qahiru fauqa 'ibadihi wa yursilu 'alaykum hafazatan hatta iza ja'a ahadakumu-mawtu tawaffathu rusuluna wa hum la yu-farritun) (6:61), Woh apne bandon par ghalib hai woh tumhari hifazat ke liye tumhare pas farishte bhejta hai yahan tak ke tum mein se kisi ki maut ka waqt ajaye toh hamare bheje hue farishte usay faut kar lete hain aur woh koi qasoor nahi karte phir sab ke sab apne sachche Maula ki taraf lautaye jate hain yaqeen mano ke hukm usi ka chalta hai aur woh sab se jald hisab lene wala hai. Surah Qiyamah ki tafseer Alhamdulillah khatam hui.

Jab hamari rooh halq tak pahunch jati hai aur us ke baad kya hota hai yahan maut ka aur sakraat ki kaifiyat ka bayan ho raha hai Allah Ta'ala hamein us waqt haq par sabit qadam rakhe. (Kalla) ko agar yahan daant ke ma'ane mein liya jaye toh yeh ma'ane honge ke "Aaye Ibn-e-Adam tu jo meri khabron ko jhutlata hai yeh durust nahi balki un ke muqaddamaat toh tu rozmarra khullam khula dekh raha hai" aur agar is lafz ko (Haqqa) ke ma'ane mein lein toh matlab aur zyada zahir hai yaani yeh baat yaqeeni hai ke jab teri rooh tere jism se nikalne lage aur tere nakhare tak pahunch jaye (Taraqi) jama hai (Tarquwa) ki un haddiyon ko kehte hain jo seene par aur mundhon ke darmiyan mein hain jise haans ki haddi kehte hain, jaise aur jagah hai (Falaula iza balagatil hulqum) (Al-Waqi'ah: 83) farmaya hai yaani jabke rooh halq tak pahunch jaye aur tum dekh rahe ho aur hum tum se bhi zyada us ke qareeb hain lekin tum nahi dekh sakte pas agar tum hukm-e-ilahi ke matahat nahi ho aur apne us qaul mein sachhe ho toh us rooh ko kyun nahi lota late? Is maqam par us hadith par bhi nazar daal li jaye jo Bishr bin Hajjaj ki riwayat se Surah Yasin ki tafsir mein guzar chuki hai, (Taraqi) jo jama hai (Tarquwa) ki un haddiyon ko kehte hain jo (Hulqum) ke qareeb hain us waqt haaye duhai hoti hai ke koi hai jo jhaar phoonk kare yaani kisi tabeeb waghera ke zariye shifa ho sakti hai? Aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke yeh farishton ka qaul hai yaani us rooh ko le kar kaun chadhega rahmat ke farishte ya azab ke? Aur pandli se pandli ke ragda khane ka ek matlab toh Hazrat Ibn Abbas waghera se yeh marwi hai ke duniya aur akhirat us par jama ho jati hai duniya ka aakhiri din hota hai aur akhirat ka pehla din hota hai jis se sakhti aur sakht ho jati hai magar jis par Rabb-e-Raheem ka rahm-o-karam ho, doosra matlab Hazrat Ikrimah se yeh marwi hai ke ek bahut bada ameer doosre bahut bade ameer se mil jata hai bala par bala aa jati hai, teesra matlab Hazrat Hasan Basri waghera se marwi hai ke khud marne wale ki be-qarari, shiddat-e-dard se paon par paon ka chadh jana murad hai. Pehle toh in pairon par chalta firta tha ab in mein jaan kahan?

Aur yeh bhi marwi hai ke kafan ke waqt pandli se pandli ka mil jana murad hai, chautha matlab Hazrat Dahhak se yeh bhi marwi hai ke do kaam do taraf jama hojate hain idhar to log us ke jism ko nehla dhula kar supurd-e-khak karne ko tayar hain idhar farishte us ki rooh le jane mein mashghool hain agar naik hai toh umda tayari aur dhoom ke sath agar bad hai toh nihayat hi burai aur badtar halat ke sath ab lautne, qarar pane, rehne sehne, pohch jane khich kar aur chal kar pohchne ki jagah Allah hi ki taraf hai rooh asman ki taraf charhai jati hai phir wahan se hukm hota hai ke usay zameen ki taraf wapas le jao maine un sab ko usi se paida kiya hai usi mein lota kar le jaunga aur phir usi se unhein dobara nikalunga, jaise ke Hazrat Bara' ki mutawwal hadis mein aya hai, yahi mazmoon aur jagah bayan hua hai ayat (Wa huwal-qahiru fauqa 'ibadihi wa yursilu 'alaykum hafazatan hatta iza ja'a ahadakumu-mawtu tawaffathu rusuluna wa hum la yu-farritun) (6:61), Woh apne bandon par ghalib hai woh tumhari hifazat ke liye tumhare pas farishte bhejta hai yahan tak ke tum mein se kisi ki maut ka waqt ajaye toh hamare bheje hue farishte usay faut kar lete hain aur woh koi qasoor nahi karte phir sab ke sab apne sachche Maula ki taraf lautaye jate hain yaqeen mano ke hukm usi ka chalta hai aur woh sab se jald hisab lene wala hai. Phir us kafir insan ka hal bayan ho raha hai jo apne dil aur aqeedah se haq ka jhutlane wala aur apne badan aur amal se haq se rogardani karne wala tha jis ka zahir batin barbad ho chuka tha aur koi bhalai us mein baqi nahi rahi thi, na woh Allah ki baaton ki dil se tasdeeq karta tha na jism se ibadat Allah baja lata tha yahan tak ke namaz ka bhi chor tha, han jhutlane aur munh marone mein be-bak tha aur apne is nakara amal par utrata aur phoolta huwa be-himati aur bad-amli ke sath apne walon mein ja milta tha, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Wa iza-inqalabu ila ahlihimunqalabu fakiheen) (83:31) yaani jab apne walon ki taraf lautte hain toh khoob baten banate huwe maze karte huwe khush khush jate hain aur jagah hai ayat (Innahu kana fi ahlihi masrooran) yani yeh apne gharane walon mein shadman tha aur samajh raha tha ke Allah ki taraf usay lotna hi nahi. Us ka yeh khayal mahz ghalat tha us ke Rab ki nigahen us par thin, phir usay Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala dhamkata hai aur dar sunata hai aur farmata hai kharabi ho tujhe Allah ke sath kufr kar ke phir utrata hai. Jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Zuq inna antal-'azizul-kareem) (44:49) yaani Qayamat ke din kafir se batur dant aur haqarat ke kaha jayega ke le ab maza chakh tu to bari izzat aur buzurgi wala tha aur farman hai ayat (Kulu wa tamatta'u qalilan innakum mujrimun) (77:46).

(Al-Mursalat: 46) Kuch kha pi lo akhir to badkar gunahgar ho aur jagah hai ayat (FA'BUDU MA SHI'TUM MIN DUNIHII QUL INNAL-KHASIRINALLADHINA KHASIRU ANFUSAHUM WA AHLIYAHUM YAWMAL-QIYAMATI ALA ZALIKA HUWAL-KHUSRANUL-MUBIN) 39. (Az-Zumar: 15) jao Allah ke siva jis ki chaho ibadat karo vagaira vagaira gharz yeh hai ki in tamam jagahon mein yeh ahkam bataur dant dapt ke hain. Hazrat Sa'eed bin Jubair se jab yeh ayat (AWLA LAKA FA-AWLA) 75. (Al-Qiyamah: 34), ki babat pucha gaya to Aap ne farmaya Rasool-e-Maqbool ﷺ ne yeh Abu Jahl ko farmaya tha phir Quran mein bhi yehi alfaz nazil hue, Hazrat Ibn Abbas se bhi isi ke qareeb qareeb Nasai mein maujood hai, Ibn Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Qatadah ki riwayat hai ki Huzoor ﷺ ke is farman par us dushman-e-Rab ne kaha ki kya tu mujhe dhamkata hai? Aur yeh bhi kaha gaya hai ke yeh farishton ka qaul hai yaani us rooh ko le kar kaun chadhega rahmat ke farishte ya azab ke? Aur pandli se pandli ke ragda khane ka ek matlab toh Hazrat Ibn Abbas waghera se yeh marwi hai ke duniya aur akhirat us par jama ho jati hai duniya ka aakhiri din hota hai aur akhirat ka pehla din hota hai jis se sakhti aur sakht ho jati hai magar jis par Rabb-e-Raheem ka rahm-o-karam ho, doosra matlab Hazrat Ikrimah se yeh marwi hai ke ek bahut bada ameer doosre bahut bade ameer se mil jata hai bala par bala aa jati hai, teesra matlab Hazrat Hasan Basri waghera se marwi hai ke khud marne wale ki be-qarari, shiddat-e-dard se paon par paon ka chadh jana murad hai. Pehle toh in pairon par chalta firta tha ab in mein jaan kahan?

Aur yeh bhi marwi hai ke kafan ke waqt pandli se pandli ka mil jana murad hai, chautha matlab Hazrat Dahhak se yeh bhi marwi hai ke do kaam do taraf jama hojate hain idhar to log us ke jism ko nehla dhula kar supurd-e-khak karne ko tayar hain idhar farishte us ki rooh le jane mein mashghool hain agar naik hai toh umda tayari aur dhoom ke sath agar bad hai toh nihayat hi burai aur badtar halat ke sath ab lautne, qarar pane, rehne sehne, pohch jane khich kar aur chal kar pohchne ki jagah Allah hi ki taraf hai rooh asman ki taraf charhai jati hai phir wahan se hukm hota hai ke usay zameen ki taraf wapas le jao maine un sab ko usi se paida kiya hai usi mein lota kar le jaunga aur phir usi se unhein dobara nikalunga, jaise ke Hazrat Bara' ki mutawwal hadis mein aya hai, yahi mazmoon aur jagah bayan hua hai ayat (Wa huwal-qahiru fauqa 'ibadihi wa yursilu 'alaykum hafazatan hatta iza ja'a ahadakumu-mawtu tawaffathu rusuluna wa hum la yu-farritun) (6:61), Woh apne bandon par ghalib hai woh tumhari hifazat ke liye tumhare pas farishte bhejta hai yahan tak ke tum mein se kisi ki maut ka waqt ajaye toh hamare bheje hue farishte usay faut kar lete hain aur woh koi qasoor nahi karte phir sab ke sab apne sachche Maula ki taraf lautaye jate hain yaqeen mano ke hukm usi ka chalta hai aur woh sab se jald hisab lene wala hai. Phir us kafir insan ka hal bayan ho raha hai jo apne dil aur aqeedah se haq ka jhutlane wala aur apne badan aur amal se haq se rogardani karne wala tha jis ka zahir batin barbad ho chuka tha aur koi bhalai us mein baqi nahi rahi thi, na woh Allah ki baaton ki dil se tasdeeq karta tha na jism se ibadat Allah baja lata tha yahan tak ke namaz ka bhi chor tha, han jhutlane aur munh marone mein be-bak tha aur apne is nakara amal par utrata aur phoolta huwa be-himati aur bad-amli ke sath apne walon mein ja milta tha, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Wa iza-inqalabu ila ahlihimunqalabu fakiheen) (83:31) yaani jab apne walon ki taraf lautte hain toh khoob baten banate huwe maze karte huwe khush khush jate hain aur jagah hai ayat (Innahu kana fi ahlihi masrooran) yani yeh apne gharane walon mein shadman tha aur samajh raha tha ke Allah ki taraf usay lotna hi nahi. Us ka yeh khayal mahz ghalat tha us ke Rab ki nigahen us par thin, phir usay Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala dhamkata hai aur dar sunata hai aur farmata hai kharabi ho tujhe Allah ke sath kufr kar ke phir utrata hai. Jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Zuq inna antal-'azizul-kareem) (44:49) yaani Qayamat ke din kafir se batur dant aur haqarat ke kaha jayega ke le ab maza chakh tu to bari izzat aur buzurgi wala tha aur farman hai ayat (Kulu wa tamatta'u qalilan innakum mujrimun) (77:46).

(Al-Mursalat: 46) Kuch kha pi lo akhir to badkar gunahgar ho aur jagah hai ayat (FA'BUDU MA SHI'TUM MIN DUNIHII QUL INNAL-KHASIRINALLADHINA KHASIRU ANFUSAHUM WA AHLIYAHUM YAWMAL-QIYAMATI ALA ZALIKA HUWAL-KHUSRANUL-MUBIN) 39. (Az-Zumar: 15) jao Allah ke siva jis ki chaho ibadat karo vagaira vagaira gharz yeh hai ki in tamam jagahon mein yeh ahkam bataur dant dapt ke hain. Hazrat Sa'eed bin Jubair se jab yeh ayat (AWLA LAKA FA-AWLA) 75. (Al-Qiyamah: 34), ki babat pucha gaya to Aap ne farmaya Rasool-e-Maqbool ﷺ ne yeh Abu Jahl ko farmaya tha phir Quran mein bhi yehi alfaz nazil hue, Hazrat Ibn Abbas se bhi isi ke qareeb qareeb Nasai mein maujood hai, Ibn Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Qatadah ki riwayat hai ki Huzoor ﷺ ke is farman par us dushman-e-Rab ne kaha ki kya tu mujhe dhamkata hai? Allah ki qasam tu aur tera Rab mera kuch nahi bigad sakte, in dono pahadiyon ke darmiyan chalne walon mein sab se zyada zi-izzat main hoon. Kya insan yeh samajhta hai ki use yunhi chhor diya jayega? Use koi hukum aur kisi cheez ki mamanat na ki jayegi? Aisa hargiz nahi balki duniya mein use hukum-o-mamanat aur akhirat mein apne apne aamal ke bamujab jaza-o-saza zaroor milegi, maqsad yahan par Qiyamat ka isbat aur munkirin-e-Qiyamat ka radd hai, isi liye daleel ke taur par kaha jata hai ki insan darasal nutfah ki shakl mein be-jan-o-be-buniyaad tha pani ka zaleel qatra tha jo peeth se rahm mein aya phir khoon ki phatki bani, phir gosht ka lothra hua, phir Allah Ta'ala ne shakl-o-soorat de kar rooh phonki aur salim a'za wala insan bana kar mard ya aurat ki soorat mein paida kiya. Kya Allah jis ne nutfah-e-zaeef ko aisa sahih-ul-qamat qawi insan bana diya woh is baat par qadir nahi ki use fana kar ke phir dobara paida kar karde? Yaqinan pehli martaba ka paida karne wala dobara banane par bohat zyada aur bataur-e-awla qadir hai, ya kam az kam utna hi jitna pehli martaba tha. Jaise farmaya (WA HUWAL-LADHI YABDA'UL-KHALQA THUMMA YU'IDUHU WA HUWA AHWANU 'ALAYHI) 30. (Ar-Rum: 27) Us ne ibtida paida kiya wahi phir lautayega aur woh is par bohat zyada asan hai.

Is ayat ke matlab mein bhi do qaul hain, lekin pehla qaul hi zyada mashhoor hai jaise ke Surah Room ki tafseer mein is ka bayan aur taqreer guzar chuki Wallahu A'lam, Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke ek Sahabi R.A apni chhat par ba-awaz-e-buland Quran Shareef parh rahe thay jab is surat ki aakhri ayat ki tilawat ki toh farmaya (Subhanakal-Lahumma qabli) yaani Aye Allah tu paak hai aur beshak qadir hai, logon ne is kehne ka baa'is poocha toh farmaya maine Rasool Allah ﷺ ko is ayat ka yehi jawab dete hue suna hai Abu Dawood mein bhi yeh hadees hai, lekin dono kitabon mein us Sahabi ka naam nahi go yeh naam na hona muzir nahi, Abu Dawood ki aur hadees mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya jo shakhs tum mein se Surah Wat-Tin ki aakhri ayat (A Laisal-Lahu bi-ahkamil-hakimeen) (At-Tin: 8) parhe woh (Bala wa ana ala zalika minash-shahideen) kahe yaani haan aur main bhi is par gawah hoon aur jo shakhs Surah Al-Qiyamah ki aakhri ayat (A laisa zalika bi-qadirin ala an yuhyil-mawta) (Al-Qiyamah: 40) parhe toh woh kahe (Bala) aur jo shakhs Surah Al-Mursalat ki aakhri ayat (Fa bi-ayyi hadeesin ba'da hu yu'minoon) (Al-Mursalat: 50) parhe woh (Amanna billah) kahe yeh hadees Musnad Ahmad aur Tirmidhi mein bhi hai, Ibn Jareer mein Hazrat Qatadah se marwi hai ke Nabi ﷺ is aakhri ayat ke baad farmate (Subhanaka wa bala) Hazrat Ibn Abbas se is ayat ke jawab mein yeh kehna Ibn Abi Hatim mein marwi hai. Surah Qiyamah ki tafseer Alhamdulillah khatam hui.

Phir us kafir insan ka hal bayan ho raha hai jo apne dil aur aqeedah se haq ka jhutlane wala aur apne badan aur amal se haq se rogardani karne wala tha jis ka zahir batin barbad ho chuka tha aur koi bhalai us mein baqi nahi rahi thi, na woh Allah ki baaton ki dil se tasdeeq karta tha na jism se ibadat Allah baja lata tha yahan tak ke namaz ka bhi chor tha, han jhutlane aur munh marone mein be-bak tha aur apne is nakara amal par utrata aur phoolta huwa be-himati aur bad-amli ke sath apne walon mein ja milta tha, jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Wa iza-inqalabu ila ahlihimunqalabu fakiheen) (83:31) yaani jab apne walon ki taraf lautte hain toh khoob baten banate huwe maze karte huwe khush khush jate hain aur jagah hai ayat (Innahu kana fi ahlihi masrooran) yani yeh apne gharane walon mein shadman tha aur samajh raha tha ke Allah ki taraf usay lotna hi nahi. Us ka yeh khayal mahz ghalat tha us ke Rab ki nigahen us par thin, phir usay Allah Tabaraka wa Ta'ala dhamkata hai aur dar sunata hai aur farmata hai kharabi ho tujhe Allah ke sath kufr kar ke phir utrata hai. Jaise aur jagah hai ayat (Zuq inna antal-'azizul-kareem) (44:49) yaani Qayamat ke din kafir se batur dant aur haqarat ke kaha jayega ke le ab maza chakh tu to bari izzat aur buzurgi wala tha aur farman hai ayat (Kulu wa tamatta'u qalilan innakum mujrimun) (77:46).

(Al-Mursalat: 46) Kuch kha pi lo akhir to badkar gunahgar ho aur jagah hai ayat (FA'BUDU MA SHI'TUM MIN DUNIHII QUL INNAL-KHASIRINALLADHINA KHASIRU ANFUSAHUM WA AHLIYAHUM YAWMAL-QIYAMATI ALA ZALIKA HUWAL-KHUSRANUL-MUBIN) 39. (Az-Zumar: 15) jao Allah ke siva jis ki chaho ibadat karo vagaira vagaira gharz yeh hai ki in tamam jagahon mein yeh ahkam bataur dant dapt ke hain. Hazrat Sa'eed bin Jubair se jab yeh ayat (AWLA LAKA FA-AWLA) 75. (Al-Qiyamah: 34), ki babat pucha gaya to Aap ne farmaya Rasool-e-Maqbool ﷺ ne yeh Abu Jahl ko farmaya tha phir Quran mein bhi yehi alfaz nazil hue, Hazrat Ibn Abbas se bhi isi ke qareeb qareeb Nasai mein maujood hai, Ibn Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Qatadah ki riwayat hai ki Huzoor ﷺ ke is farman par us dushman-e-Rab ne kaha ki kya tu mujhe dhamkata hai? Allah ki qasam tu aur tera Rab mera kuch nahi bigad sakte, in dono pahadiyon ke darmiyan chalne walon mein sab se zyada zi-izzat main hoon. Kya insan yeh samajhta hai ki use yunhi chhor diya jayega? Use koi hukum aur kisi cheez ki mamanat na ki jayegi? Aisa hargiz nahi balki duniya mein use hukum-o-mamanat aur akhirat mein apne apne aamal ke bamujab jaza-o-saza zaroor milegi, maqsad yahan par Qiyamat ka isbat aur munkirin-e-Qiyamat ka radd hai, isi liye daleel ke taur par kaha jata hai ki insan darasal nutfah ki shakl mein be-jan-o-be-buniyaad tha pani ka zaleel qatra tha jo peeth se rahm mein aya phir khoon ki phatki bani, phir gosht ka lothra hua, phir Allah Ta'ala ne shakl-o-soorat de kar rooh phonki aur salim a'za wala insan bana kar mard ya aurat ki soorat mein paida kiya. Kya Allah jis ne nutfah-e-zaeef ko aisa sahih-ul-qamat qawi insan bana diya woh is baat par qadir nahi ki use fana kar ke phir dobara paida kar karde? Yaqinan pehli martaba ka paida karne wala dobara banane par bohat zyada aur bataur-e-awla qadir hai, ya kam az kam utna hi jitna pehli martaba tha. Jaise farmaya (WA HUWAL-LADHI YABDA'UL-KHALQA THUMMA YU'IDUHU WA HUWA AHWANU 'ALAYHI) 30. (Ar-Rum: 27) Us ne ibtida paida kiya wahi phir lautayega aur woh is par bohat zyada asan hai.

Is ayat ke matlab mein bhi do qaul hain, lekin pehla qaul hi zyada mashhoor hai jaise ke Surah Room ki tafseer mein is ka bayan aur taqreer guzar chuki Wallahu A'lam, Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke ek Sahabi R.A apni chhat par ba-awaz-e-buland Quran Shareef parh rahe thay jab is surat ki aakhri ayat ki tilawat ki toh farmaya (Subhanakal-Lahumma qabli) yaani Aye Allah tu paak hai aur beshak qadir hai, logon ne is kehne ka baa'is poocha toh farmaya maine Rasool Allah ﷺ ko is ayat ka yehi jawab dete hue suna hai Abu Dawood mein bhi yeh hadees hai, lekin dono kitabon mein us Sahabi ka naam nahi go yeh naam na hona muzir nahi, Abu Dawood ki aur hadees mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya jo shakhs tum mein se Surah Wat-Tin ki aakhri ayat (A Laisal-Lahu bi-ahkamil-hakimeen) (At-Tin: 8) parhe woh (Bala wa ana ala zalika minash-shahideen) kahe yaani haan aur main bhi is par gawah hoon aur jo shakhs Surah Al-Qiyamah ki aakhri ayat (A laisa zalika bi-qadirin ala an yuhyil-mawta) (Al-Qiyamah: 40) parhe toh woh kahe (Bala) aur jo shakhs Surah Al-Mursalat ki aakhri ayat (Fa bi-ayyi hadeesin ba'da hu yu'minoon) (Al-Mursalat: 50) parhe woh (Amanna billah) kahe yeh hadees Musnad Ahmad aur Tirmidhi mein bhi hai, Ibn Jareer mein Hazrat Qatadah se marwi hai ke Nabi ﷺ is aakhri ayat ke baad farmate (Subhanaka wa bala) Hazrat Ibn Abbas se is ayat ke jawab mein yeh kehna Ibn Abi Hatim mein marwi hai. Surah Qiyamah ki tafseer Alhamdulillah khatam hui.

Hazrat Sa'eed bin Jubair se jab yeh ayat (AWLA LAKA FA-AWLA) 75. (Al-Qiyamah: 34), ki babat pucha gaya to Aap ne farmaya Rasool-e-Maqbool ﷺ ne yeh Abu Jahl ko farmaya tha phir Quran mein bhi yehi alfaz nazil hue, Hazrat Ibn Abbas se bhi isi ke qareeb qareeb Nasai mein maujood hai, Ibn Abi Hatim mein Hazrat Qatadah ki riwayat hai ki Huzoor ﷺ ke is farman par us dushman-e-Rab ne kaha ki kya tu mujhe dhamkata hai? Allah ki qasam tu aur tera Rab mera kuch nahi bigad sakte, in dono pahadiyon ke darmiyan chalne walon mein sab se zyada zi-izzat main hoon. Kya insan yeh samajhta hai ki use yunhi chhor diya jayega? Use koi hukum aur kisi cheez ki mamanat na ki jayegi? Aisa hargiz nahi balki duniya mein use hukum-o-mamanat aur akhirat mein apne apne aamal ke bamujab jaza-o-saza zaroor milegi, maqsad yahan par Qiyamat ka isbat aur munkirin-e-Qiyamat ka radd hai, isi liye daleel ke taur par kaha jata hai ki insan darasal nutfah ki shakl mein be-jan-o-be-buniyaad tha pani ka zaleel qatra tha jo peeth se rahm mein aya phir khoon ki phatki bani, phir gosht ka lothra hua, phir Allah Ta'ala ne shakl-o-soorat de kar rooh phonki aur salim a'za wala insan bana kar mard ya aurat ki soorat mein paida kiya. Kya Allah jis ne nutfah-e-zaeef ko aisa sahih-ul-qamat qawi insan bana diya woh is baat par qadir nahi ki use fana kar ke phir dobara paida kar karde? Yaqinan pehli martaba ka paida karne wala dobara banane par bohat zyada aur bataur-e-awla qadir hai, ya kam az kam utna hi jitna pehli martaba tha. Jaise farmaya (WA HUWAL-LADHI YABDA'UL-KHALQA THUMMA YU'IDUHU WA HUWA AHWANU 'ALAYHI) 30. (Ar-Rum: 27) Us ne ibtida paida kiya wahi phir lautayega aur woh is par bohat zyada asan hai.

Is ayat ke matlab mein bhi do qaul hain, lekin pehla qaul hi zyada mashhoor hai jaise ke Surah Room ki tafseer mein is ka bayan aur taqreer guzar chuki Wallahu A'lam, Ibn Abi Hatim mein hai ke ek Sahabi R.A apni chhat par ba-awaz-e-buland Quran Shareef parh rahe thay jab is surat ki aakhri ayat ki tilawat ki toh farmaya (Subhanakal-Lahumma qabli) yaani Aye Allah tu paak hai aur beshak qadir hai, logon ne is kehne ka baa'is poocha toh farmaya maine Rasool Allah ﷺ ko is ayat ka yehi jawab dete hue suna hai Abu Dawood mein bhi yeh hadees hai, lekin dono kitabon mein us Sahabi ka naam nahi go yeh naam na hona muzir nahi, Abu Dawood ki aur hadees mein hai ke Rasool Allah ﷺ ne farmaya jo shakhs tum mein se Surah Wat-Tin ki aakhri ayat (A Laisal-Lahu bi-ahkamil-hakimeen) (At-Tin: 8) parhe woh (Bala wa ana ala zalika minash-shahideen) kahe yaani haan aur main bhi is par gawah hoon aur jo shakhs Surah Al-Qiyamah ki aakhri ayat (A laisa zalika bi-qadirin ala an yuhyil-mawta) (Al-Qiyamah: 40) parhe toh woh kahe (Bala) aur jo shakhs Surah Al-Mursalat ki aakhri ayat (Fa bi-ayyi hadeesin ba'da hu yu'minoon) (Al-Mursalat: 50) parhe woh (Amanna billah) kahe yeh hadees Musnad Ahmad aur Tirmidhi mein bhi hai, Ibn Jareer mein Hazrat Qatadah se marwi hai ke Nabi ﷺ is aakhri ayat ke baad farmate (Subhanaka wa bala) Hazrat Ibn Abbas se is ayat ke jawab mein yeh kehna Ibn Abi Hatim mein marwi hai. Surah Qiyamah ki tafseer Alhamdulillah khatam hui.
